summary: Nocera, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Strategic Advisory Agreement with Phoenix MGMT Consulting LLC for non-exclusive advisory and execution support. Compensation includes an initial $150,000 retainer, $50,000/month cash, $50,000/quarter in restricted shares (priced at 5-day VWAP), and a 5% transaction fee (cash/stock split) on deals Phoenix introduces. The unregistered shares rely on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D accredited-investor exemption. The 90-day term can be extended. This is an advisory hiring, not a transformative event; watch for any future M&A introductions that could trigger the transaction fee and signal strategic shifts.
